description: This file defines a utility object 'PostPlaybackDescriptorsBinder' that provides a method to bind a list of descriptor strings into a UI layout, managing visibility and dynamically creating TextViews for each descriptor.

classes.name: PostPlaybackDescriptorsBinder
classes.description: A singleton object providing a static method to bind a list of descriptors to a layout.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a list of descriptor strings to a LinearLayout, updating visibility states and creating TextViews for each descriptor.
